categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in residential and commercial building development, including detached houses, community buildings, commercial buildings, industrial plants, and office building leasing. It also operates in industrial park development, urban renewal projects, and hotel-style apartment operations. The company has diversified into commercial real estate leasing and hotel management, accumulating experience in multiple real estate sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction methods with strict quality and cost control, integrating green building and energy-saving concepts. It uses building technologies such as seismic and vibration control, green low-carbon design, and smart building certifications. The company emphasizes sustainable materials, digital service platforms for customer interaction, and continuous innovation in architectural design and construction management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are homebuyers and commercial tenants in Taiwan, especially in the Taichung metropolitan area and Taipei. The company targets high-end residential buyers, commercial tenants for office and industrial spaces, and hotel guests for its serviced apartments. It also serves government agencies through urban renewal projects and collaborates with industrial clients for factory and office space development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in Taiwan, focusing on the Taichung metropolitan area and expanding into the Greater Taipei area. It participates in urban renewal projects in Taipei and develops residential and commercial properties primarily in central and northern Taiwan. There is no indication of overseas operations or listings.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land development, design, construction management, and property leasing. It outsources construction to its subsidiary construction firm but controls project planning, sales, and property management. It acts as a developer and property manager, coordinating upstream suppliers like landowners and building material providers and downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on sustainable development, green building, and energy efficiency aligned with Taiwan's net-zero goals. It invests in R&D for innovative architectural design, smart building technologies, and diversified product offerings including high-end residences, commercial offices, and hotel apartments. The company emphasizes brand building, digital marketing, and customer service innovation to maintain market leadership and respond to evolving customer needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of residential and commercial properties, rental income from office buildings and hotel-style apartments, and property management services. The company also earns income from urban renewal projects and industrial park developments. Its revenue streams include project completion sales, leasing contracts, and recurring rental income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other major real estate developers in Taiwan, particularly those focusing on high-end residential and commercial properties. It positions itself as a premium brand emphasizing quality, sustainability, and diversified real estate services. Its competitive advantages include strong brand recognition, integrated development and construction capabilities, and experience in urban renewal projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$4.5 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a net profit of around NT$594 million. Although revenue and profit declined compared to the previous year due to market conditions, the company maintains a stable financial position with total assets exceeding NT$17 billion and equity over NT$5 billion. It has a steady growth trajectory with ongoing development projects valued at billions of NT dollars.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, sustainable, and innovative building products tailored to customer needs, integrating aesthetics, lifestyle, and environmental sustainability. It differentiates through comprehensive after-sales service, digital customer engagement platforms, and a diversified portfolio including residential, commercial, industrial, and hospitality properties. Its brand is associated with trust, professionalism, and responsiveness to market trends and regulatory changes.
